titulo.estudio: Lire un débat contemporain : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: Reading a current debate: Finding the details

intro: Reconstruct the debate and separate fact, opinion and proposal in texts on a current topic. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Reconstruct the debate and separate fact, opinion and proposal in texts on a current topic. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: verbal attributions and reservation markers show how far each source backs a claim. In this passage, «débat» means «debate».

frases.estudio: Le débat sur les bibliothèques ouvertes le soir porte autant sur l'accès aux services que sur les conditions de travail.
frases.alumno: The debate about opening libraries in the evening is about access to services as much as working conditions.

frases.estudio: Les usagers interrogés estiment que ces horaires faciliteraient les études, notamment pour les personnes salariées.
frases.alumno: The users interviewed think that these hours would make studying easier, especially for those who work.
